summary: Frontend-only non-regression sweep after final AdMob config (real iOS/Android app IDs + platform-specific banner unit IDs) on Expo web preview (390x844). CGU accepted, email/password login (mobiletest123@aqua.com / Test1234!) OK. ZERO pageerrors, ZERO red-screen crashes across the whole flow. AdBanner correctly returns null on web (data-testid=ad-banner count=0) — expected, native-only by design. All Premium-gated features still present for the FREE test user: (a) Aquacoach tab renders chat + shows 'Vous avez utilisé vos messages gratuits' free counter; (b) Aquanalyse on Progrès tab renders insights-score AND insight-tip-0; (c) Points d'eau via Profil > link-waterpoints shows wp-locked gate + wp-unlock CTA; (d) Santé screen via Profil > link-health shows health-locked upsell; (e) Premium screen via profile-premium-button opens fully ('Aquadify Premium' hero + premium-subscribe-button = Devenir Premium + premium-close). Delete-account modal (Profil > Zone sensible > delete-account-button) opens with the full double confirmation flow: delete-continue → delete-confirm → delete-cancel works and dismisses. Home renders drop progress (0%/2450 ml visible), Ajout rapide (quick-add-glass/cup/bottle/large_bottle/custom), Points d'eau card, no crash after AdBanner mount.
